display_name: NVIDIA B200 (HGX/DGX B200, 8 GPUs per node)

memory_bytes_per_gpu.note: Derived: DGX B200 'GPU Memory 1,440 GB total' over 8 GPUs = 180 GB (decimal) per GPU.

bf16_dense_flops_per_gpu.note: Derived: HGX B200 'FP16/BF16 Tensor Core 36 PFLOPS' is a sparse figure for 8 GPUs (footnote: 'Dense is 1/2 sparse spec shown'), so 18 PFLOPS dense / 8 = 2.25 PFLOPS per GPU.
